summary: Frontend-only test of Phase 4b — Self-Defense Guided Session Player. 35/36 assertions PASS across all 7 requested flows + auto-advance + drill cadence + voice persistence + completion. The single failing line is a TEST-DETECTION limitation, not a product bug (react-native-web's Alert.alert renders an in-DOM modal rather than calling window.confirm/alert, so my window.__alerts hook captured nothing — but functionally cancel keeps the player open and Exit navigates back, so the close-confirmation works as specified). Auth: minted MongoDB user (TEST_FE_iter10_user) + user_sessions row and injected sanctus_session_token into localStorage. Generated a real Boxing session (sd_c8b5f2df4a744a) via Claude through /api/self-defense/generate, then drove the player end-to-end at viewport 390x844.
action_items: No fixes required. All 7 requested flows pass functionally.

(Optional, not blocking) Tests using window.confirm/alert hooking will not catch react-native-web Alert.alert dialogs because RNW renders an in-DOM modal. Future test scripts should detect Alert by querying the DOM for an element with role='alertdialog' or text 'Exit session?' rather than overriding window.confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: sd-player.ts parseSets regex uses /[x×]/ — correctly matches both ASCII 'x' and unicode multiplication sign '×' so plan strings like '3 × 60 seconds' (from Claude) parse correctly (verified live).
Player AppState listener pauses on background (good for mobile). Web doesn't fire 'background', so this is iOS/Android-only — fine.
Voice util uses try/catch around expo-speech calls and Speech.getAvailableVoicesAsync — safely silent if unsupported on web.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (35/35 functional assertions; 1 detection limitation, not a bug)

seed_data_creation: Inserted users + user_sessions row (TEST_FE_iter10_user / TEST_FE_ITERATION10_TOKEN). Generated one real Claude-backed self-defense session sd_c8b5f2df4a744a (Boxing, 20min). The session was POSTed /complete during the completion-flow test so it is now marked completed in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-use TEST_FE_iter10_user + TEST_FE_ITERATION10_TOKEN by injecting localStorage['sanctus_session_token']=JSON.stringify(token) at the root path before navigating into the app. Note that sd_c8b5f2df4a744a is now marked complete; if a non-completed Boxing session is needed for player re-tests, either generate a new one (≈90s Claude latency) or POST /api/self-defense/sessions/{id}/uncomplete first.
